content.title: Dungeon Rush
about: Dungeon Rush was my first attempt at building a 3D action/RPG-style prototype on my own.
The goal of this project was learning the fundamentals of 3D gameplay: movement, camera, basic combat, and dungeon-like progression.
It was published as an early personal prototype.
learnings: First steps in 3D character and camera control
Rapid prototyping to validate ideas early
Understanding scope and iteration for solo projects
